records.text: Owens said Erika Kirk attended daycare in 1991 in the Scripps corporate building at 312 Walnut Street in Cincinnati, built in 1990, and they found no evidence her parents worked there.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Oh, wow. That is incredible. You got to give it to Scripps Media. Maybe we should be taking a closer look at Scripps. And do you know what somebody emailed me and reminded me? Now, when we were doing our series on Erika Kirk, and we started with her life and the first school that she attended, particularly, we uncovered that she went to a daycare in a massive corporate building. ... We were somewhat confused because we found no evidence that her parents worked in this corporate building. It was a relatively new building. ... The building was built in 1990 and Erika (Erika Kirk) was attending daycare there in 1991. ... And it was actually the Scripps building in Cincinnati, Ohio. That's where the company was based. ... Erika (Erika Kirk) was attending that daycare at the Walnut Street, 312 Walnut Street at the corner of Third Street.
